title: Al-Kashshaf
altTitles: The Unveiler of the Realities of Revelation
author: al-zamakhshari
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Zamakhshari's commentary on the Qur'an, organised surah by surah and verse by verse, with close attention to grammar, rhetoric and the readings. Its analysis of metaphor and syntax made it a model for later exegetes, while its Mu'tazili theology provoked responses from Sunni authors who quoted its philology while rejecting its doctrine.
historicalContext: Written in Khwarazm in the twelfth century by a philologist and theologian trained in the Mu'tazili tradition. The work's literary method set the standard for rhetorical tafsir, and its theological positions were answered by al-Razi, al-Baydawi and others.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
